outcome.summary: Chats are now terminals. New chat opens the folder's agent CLI in an in-app terminal with one click, and every chat behavior runs through the terminal: resume, sign-in, the orchestrator, and old chats. The protocol adapters are removed. Verified live on macOS, built and packaged; Windows is covered by unit tests only.

provenance.note: Harden the completion guarantees introduced by Scrum cadence and reduce its procedural orchestration burden.

title: Terminal chats: New chat opens the folder's agent CLI in a terminal inside the app
